findings.details: All nine contact-sheet pages have consistent body measure and margins, visible centered page numbers, clean section/claim hierarchy and readable display structure. No visible clipping, overlapping text, black glyph boxes or equations outside the text block. The intentional page sampling is recorded exactly; missing numbers between sampled pages are not treated as blank pages.

All nine pages show consistent typography and page geometry. Proof prose, displayed arithmetic groups, subsection headings and blue citations remain within the intended text block. No visible collisions, clipping, orphaned isolated display labels or rendering corruption.

Full-resolution inspection confirms the end of D30 and start of subsection4.17/D31 are legible. The long code path stays in the text block; the remaining-finite-ramification paragraph, claim heading, italic statement, centered unit-rank inequality and Kummer display do not overlap or clip. The proof begins cleanly and the centered footer223 is unobstructed.

limitations: Contact sheets were inspected at their displayed resolution for page geometry, clipping, overlap, typography consistency and equation containment. Only page223 was additionally read at full resolution; this is not a claim to have read every glyph on the contact-sheet pages. No integrated TeX or PDF was modified.
